description: KentOS styled drawing (docs/STYLE.md §6): the style engine's batches (render/types.ts StyledBatch) as strokes, fills with a per-pixel paint and markers. The web's WebGPU backend joins these sources in this order (apps/web/src/render/webgpu/styledShaders.ts) and scripts/wgsl/browser-check.mjs compiles them in a browser's WebGPU and builds these pipelines; the native renderer is to be checked against the same file. The WebGL2 twin is apps/web/src/render/webgl2/styledShaders.ts. Any change to a struct, attribute, binding or packing raises the version. Version 2 binds the atlas in group 0 beside the frame: a native wgpu device may offer only two bind groups (Iced’s does). Version 3 (docs/adr/0157) packs a batch's positions from its tile: the frame carries the camera centre's low part (offsetLo) and each style block its tile's origin.

values.geometry: origin-relative float32 metres (render/types.ts): never absolute coordinates on the GPU
values.Frame: shared with the plain pipelines: offset = camera centre, origin-relative metres; scale = (2 × px per metre / width, 2 × px per metre / height) in logical px (clip units per metre, unused here); pxPerM = logical px per metre × dpr; dpr = device pixel ratio; viewport = device px
values.color: 0..1 RGBA of the sRGB-encoded colour as written (no linearisation), straight alpha, resolved from the theme palette on the page
values.unit: flags.x: 0 world (metres, paper mm × plot scale / 1000), 1 px (logical, times dpr)
values.dash: dash0, dash1: up to 8 on/off lengths in the batch's unit (an odd list repeated once to be even); with a.y = total and a.z = the on share (stroke), b.y and b.z (hatch)
values.stroke: seg = ax, ay, bx, by; mt = distance along the path at a (metres), end flags (1: a is a path end, 2: b is; other ends join round); a = (width, dashTotal, dashOn, dashOffset), b.x = blur, flags = (unit, cap: 0 butt, 1 round, 2 square)
values.hatch: a = (cos angle, sin angle, spacing, width), b = (offset, dashTotal, dashOn, dashOffset), flags.x = unit
values.pattern: color = fill, stroke = stroke, dash0 = (cell w, cell h, cos angle, sin angle), dash1 = (offset x, y, jitter x, y), rect = (half w, h, mark offset x, y), a = (cos, sin of the mark's rotation, coverage, seed), b = (stroke width, tint, opacity, 0), c = shape params, flags = (unit, stagger, shape, reach: 1 when neighbour cells must be looked at)
values.tile: rect = the atlas image's uv (x, y, w, h), written each frame; a = (tile w, h, cos angle, sin angle), b = (shift x, y, opacity, 0), flags.x = unit
values.marker: i0 = (x, y, angle radians, width), i1 = height; color = fill, stroke = stroke, rect = atlas uv (images), a = (offset x, y, anchor x, y), b = (aspect, stroke width, opacity, 0), c = shape params, flags = (unit, kind: 0 shape 1 image, shape, fit: 1 width 2 height)
values.shape: 0 circle, 1 ring, 2 square, 3 rectangle, 4 diamond, 5 triangle, 6 pentagon, 7 hexagon, 8 octagon, 9 star, 10 cross, 11 x, 12 line, 13 arrow, 14 arrowhead, 15 chevron, 16 semicircle, 17 quartercircle, 18 gear, 19 arc
values.atlas: one rgba8unorm 2048 × 2048 page, premultiplied, one level, sampled linearly with clamp-to-edge (tileFs insets by half a texel of 2048)
